data.gender_notes: Arvell is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arvell is an old English name, derived from the Old English words ‘eorl’ meaning noble or eagle, and ‘wellan’ meaning to boil or brighten. The name Arvell can be interpreted as ‘noble eagle’ or ‘bright one’. It was a popular name in England during the Middle Ages and was given to boys born into noble families. The name Arvell carries the meaning “Eagle or bright one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Arvell usually hope their child will grow to embody eagle or bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
